task.title: A10: dong 'toc do tai xuong' tren the Diagnostics la dong ho BI DONG — sua nhan + them 'Dinh phien' (nguon: chu du an bus #232)
task.detail:
NGUON: chu du an giao qua Telegram (bus #232, 22/09 13:38Z) -> WIN da chep vao so thanh T-20260922-18. Bao cao day du: docs/TG-VIBECODE-DIAGNOSTICS-SPEED.md (origin/flowgpt, commit b08a2fb).

VAN DE (da soat code, khong suy doan): dong "Toc do tai xuong ↓" tren the Diagnostics (A10, commit c5d7564) la dong ho BI DONG = (delta byte RX cua tunnel trong ~1s) * 8 / 1000 / dt (HysteriaPacketTunnelProvider.swift:571-590, nguon byte: TunnelBridge.fromGoBytes / utunPacketCounters). Phep tinh DUNG don vi, khong lan chieu. Nhung he qua tren dien thoai: muon NHIN thay so thi app VPNFlow phai o tien canh => app video bi iOS treo o nen => video ngung tai => so ve vai chuc kbps hoac "—". Vi vay "so rat cham" va "van xem duoc Netflix" KHONG mau thuan, va quy trinh nghiem thu §5 (scripts/measure-tunnel.sh: "Tren iPhone ... lay so o the Diagnostics cua app (A10) va chup anh") hien KHONG DUNG DUOC.

VIEC (vung cua MAC - iOS/macOS; WIN khong tu sua theo AGENTS.md §6):
1. Sua nhan 2 dong diagDown/diagUp cho dung nghia (vd "Dang truyen ↓/↑") va THEM 1 dong "Dinh phien ↓" lay tu BandwidthControl.peakDownKbps (so da co san, khong them phep do, khong them pin) de luon co mot con so noi len suc duong da dat.
2. (neu chu du an chon huong B) Them nut "Do toc do" tren the Diagnostics: tai 1 luong 2-3 MB qua tunnel (chinh la kenh do §2c da thiet ke), hien ket qua tai cho. Day la thu §5 can de nghiem thu tren iPhone.
3. Chay phep kiem chung o muc "verify" de chot: so tren the PHAI khop so that cua mot luong tai dang chay.

GIOI HAN: neu log "bw: sample observed=" cung thap trong luc dang tai that => co bug that trong chuoi do byte (TunnelBridge/utunPacketCounters) va phai mo lai viec voi bang chung log.
task.verify: Chay TREN MAY MAC: (a) bat VPNFlow + bash scripts/measure-tunnel.sh --label tunnel --minutes 1 -> ghi so Mbps that; (b) cung luc doc log extension: xcrun devicectl device copy from --device <UDID> --domain-type appDataContainer --domain-identifier com.privatevpn.app.packet-tunnel --source Documents/relay.log --destination /tmp/relay.log ; grep -E "bw: sample observed=" /tmp/relay.log | tail -20 ; (c) dan nguyen 20 dong log + so cua script: trong luc tai, observed/down PHAI ~ so Mbps cua script; luc ranh PHAI ~0 hoac the hien "—". Kem anh chup the Diagnostics (A10) tren iPhone/iPad VA tren macOS (neu macOS da port A10 o nhanh rieng thi ghi ro nhanh + commit, vi origin/main KHONG co dong nay trong app macOS).
